lines.text: Real games feel real because things fall like they do in the real world. Today you’ll code gravity!
Make a variable called vy (velocity in y).
It says how many steps the sprite moves up or down each frame.
Every frame, gravity changes vy by -1, then the sprite changes y by vy.
The fall gets faster and faster — just like a real apple.
If the sprite goes below the floor, put it back on the floor and set vy to 0 so it stops falling.
In another forever loop, check the arrow keys and change x.
Now the hero can walk and fall at the same time.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
